name: agile-mods
description: Claude Mods for the agile-skills loop: /agile-board opens the agile console pane (board with burnup and a Monte Carlo done-by forecast, ticket and PR flow, aging WIP and PR overlap, what each ticket cost with the median and cost per line, drain passes with cost, cache hit rate and the loop's agents, guards and receipts, links), read live from gh, the Jira MCP and the engine rather than from the model's answers, with a status-line entry (spend per hour and per merged PR, the 85% date) and an alert row above the prompt; guards that check GitHub at merge time (pinned live head, green CI on it, every file read by a reviewer in full or by a diff since a full read), enforce agent tool grants, cap the merge train's fix rounds after review, stop new build work on a ticket at an optional per-ticket cost cap, and refuse pushes to main and force pushes inside the loop, each set to enforce, warn or off, with a one-time bypass a person grants from the console; /receipts checks agent receipts against the contract; retro counts for agile-15. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or later.

autoOpen.title: Open the console when a drain starts
autoOpen.description: Opens the agile console pane, unfocused, when agile-sprint-drain starts. It appears only in a terminal at least 144 columns wide; /agile-board opens it at any width.

ticketBudgetUsd.title: Ticket cost cap in USD
ticketBudgetUsd.description: Spend limit for one ticket, in USD: what the agents that worked it cost this run (an estimate from their tokens). Once reached, the loop starts no new build work on that ticket and reports it blocked (BUDGET); its open PR still merges and the other tickets go on. You can lift it for one ticket from the guards tab. 0 = no cap.

guardTicketBudget.title: Guard: ticket cost cap
guardTicketBudget.description: What happens when a ticket reaches its cap. enforce = refuse its build work, warn = allow it and log a warning, off = no check.

guardGrants.title: Guard: agent tool grants
guardGrants.description: Keeps each loop agent to the tools its job needs: reviewers never edit files or post to GitHub/Jira, and the Jira postmortem never links issues. enforce = refuse the call, warn = allow it and log a warning, off = no check.

guardMergePin.title: Guard: merge pins the reviewed head
guardMergePin.description: At merge, requires --match-head-commit <reviewed sha> and that sha to be the PR's live head, so a commit pushed after the review cannot slip in. enforce = refuse the call, warn = allow it and log a warning, off = no check.

guardMergeCi.title: Guard: merge needs green CI
guardMergeCi.description: At merge, requires every CI run on the pinned head to have finished green, checked with gh, not taken from the model's word. enforce = refuse the call, warn = allow it and log a warning, off = no check.

guardMergeReview.title: Guard: merge needs every file reviewed
guardMergeReview.description: At merge, requires a reviewer to have read every changed file at the reviewed sha (in full, or as the diff since an earlier full read). The refusal lists what is missing and how to read it. enforce = refuse the call, warn = allow it and log a warning, off = no check.

guardPush.title: Guard: no push to main, no force push
guardPush.description: Inside the loop, refuses pushes to main/master, force pushes without --force-with-lease, and pushes whose target is computed ($VAR). enforce or warn; there is no off, because a push to main cannot be undone.

guardSideDoor.title: Guard: no way around the guards
guardSideDoor.description: Inside the loop, refuses ways around the other guards: branch writes or merges through the GitHub API or MCP, git/gh aliases, and git config overrides. enforce = refuse the call, warn = allow it and log a warning, off = no check.

fixRounds.title: Fix rounds per PR
fixRounds.description: Fix rounds allowed per PR after a review before the loop must block it (3d) and leave it to you. Resuming after a CI wait and restoring pushes do not count. You can grant one more round from the guards tab. 0 = no cap.

allowBypass.title: Allow one-time bypasses
allowBypass.description: Lets you allow a refused merge, an extra fix round, or a ticket over its cost cap once, from the guards tab or /agile-board allow <n>. The model can never grant one itself.
